# Reader fonts

Reader-v18 bundles Adobe's unchanged Source Han Sans CN variable WOFF2
(思源黑体, Simplified Chinese regional subset) as its default text font.
Local and system fonts cover characters outside the bundled subset.
JetBrains Mono Regular, Italic, Bold and Bold Italic remain bundled for code.
The supplied font files and notices are pinned in [provenance.json](provenance.json).
Both families use the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
[Source Han Sans license](SourceHanSans-OFL.txt) · [JetBrains Mono license](JetBrainsMono-OFL.txt)

Online readers share cacheable content-addressed font URLs. Standalone HTML and
ZIP exports embed the fonts and retain their notices, so they work offline.
Other font picker options use installed fonts.

Reader-v13 through v16 are available for reading and export from existing
publication files. Their original fonts are served from those verified
publications. New builds of these templates are retired.
